modern: How cruel it is not to allow men to strive after the things which seem to them suitable to their nature and profitable! And yet in a way you do not allow them to do this when you are annoyed because they do wrong. For they are certainly drawn towards things because they suppose them to be suitable to their nature and profitable to them. But it is not so. Teach them, then, and show them, without being angry.
